usage.result_excerpt: I wrote the parser to `main.wj`. I ran it in the interpreter on a hand-made input, and it printed the expected lines for an empty line, `,`, a field with a comma in quotes (`"x,y"`) and a field with a doubled quote (`"he said ""hi"""`). I didn't run `wj check`, and I didn't run `wj build`, so I haven't confirmed it compiles under the production toolchain. I also didn't run the two examples exactly
